source_lines: Business Analyst at HDFC Bank Ltd. (Sep 2012 – Oct 2017)
• Gathered and analyzed business requirements for banking products and process improvements.
• Led business analysis activities for banking transformation initiatives across Lending, Mortgage, Payments and Core Banking.
• Prepared BRD, FRD, RTM, process flows, use cases, and functional specifications.
• Worked on requirement documentation, stakeholder coordination, UAT, and production support.
• Supported Agile and Waterfall delivery models for banking transformation projects.
• Gathered, analyzed, and documented business, functional, and non-functional requirements through stakeholder workshops and requirement elicitation sessions.

• Prepared Business Requirement Documents (BRD), Functional Requirement Documents (FRD), Software Requirement Specifications (SRS), Functional Specification Documents (FSD), User Stories, Epics, Features, and Acceptance Criteria.
• Performed Gap Analysis, Impact Analysis, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), SWOT Analysis, Feasibility Analysis, and Process Analysis to identify business improvement opportunities.
• Created As-Is and To-Be process flows, workflow diagrams, UML use cases, activity diagrams, sequence diagrams, wireframes, mockups, and business process documentation.
• Collaborated with Product Owners, SMEs, Developers, QA teams, Architects, and business stakeholders throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
• Managed product backlog items using JIRA and maintained project documentation in Confluence.
• Participated in Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Backlog Grooming, Sprint Reviews, and Sprint Retrospectives.
• Prepared Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM) to ensure complete traceability from requirements through testing.
• Executed SQL queries for data validation, data analysis, reconciliation, and production support.
• Conducted Data Mapping, Data Validation, Data Migration analysis, and ETL validation activities.
• Supported API integration testing using REST APIs, JSON, XML, Swagger, and Postman.
• Prepared UAT Test Scenarios and Test Cases and coordinated User Acceptance Testing (UAT), SIT, Regression Testing, and defect management.
• Worked on Retail Banking, Core Banking, Digital Banking, Payments, Lending, Mortgage, KYC/AML, and Customer Onboarding initiatives.
• Supported production deployment, Hypercare activities, incident management, and release management.
